name: Being Mad
overview: Scripture teaches that being slow to anger demonstrates great understanding and wisdom, while hasty wrath leads to folly and strife. Believers are urged to cease from anger and avoid acting in wrath, as fretful anger can provoke evil. A gentle and soft response can defuse anger, whereas harsh words only escalate conflict. Additionally, the Bible warns against close association with angry or furious individuals, emphasizing the importance of self-control and discretion in speech as marks of wisdom.
